about: v0.6 shared interface strings (OWNER: v0.6 WP0): told cutscenes, hotspots, the verse book; keys v06.*. Rules: notes/sa-ui.md.

v06.pause.ctx: told cutscene (view-told): button, pause the scene — the Āditya-hṛdayam scene's word (aditya-hridayam.json ui.pause, reviewed in v0.5b)

v06.resume.ctx: told cutscene: button, go on after a pause (as aditya-hridayam.json ui.resume)

v06.skip.ctx: told cutscene: button, skip the scene (asks to confirm; as aditya-hridayam.json ui.skip)

v06.skipAsk.ctx: told cutscene: the question before skipping (yes / no: common.yes / common.no). Pattern of aditya-hridayam.json ui.skipAsk (आदित्यहृदयं त्यजसि?) with एतत् 'this'. NEW in v0.6: for rev1 / rev2

v06.look.ctx: a hidden moment (hotspot) on the map or in a told cutscene: the screen-reader / keyboard label of the shimmering spot. पश्य 'look!' (2nd sg. imperative of दृश्). NEW in v0.6: for rev1 / rev2
